body:
## Problem

When a gas-mask enemy throws a chemical grenade and illusion copies are spawned (`ChemicalCloud._spawn_illusions_for_nearby_enemies`), the original enemy was teleported to a random offset (60-120 px) around its current position. In narrow corridors this occasionally placed the enemy inside or behind wall geometry, leaving the real enemy unreachable.

After the first fix, owner feedback on 2026-04-25 reported that the gas was visible but illusion copies did not seem to appear. The attached logs showed that copies were actually spawned, but the per-cloud cap was spent on enemies returned early by scene-tree order, often far away from the visible gas/player encounter.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1632

## Approach

This PR keeps the surgical wall-safety fix and adds a second targeted correction for the review feedback:

1. Before teleporting the original enemy, candidate destinations are validated with `intersect_point` and `intersect_ray` against obstacle layer 3 (`collision_mask = 4`).
2. Alive enemies are now sorted by distance to the chemical cloud before spending the per-cloud illusion cap, so local enemies near the visible gas are processed first.
3. Offset 0 remains the no-move fallback when every random offset is unsafe.

No gas cloud visual, grow-in, PackedScene instantiation, or grenade pipeline code is changed.

## Case Study

Downloaded and preserved owner-provided logs plus issue/PR metadata under:

- `docs/case-studies/issue-1632/`

Key finding: the 2026-04-25 logs repeatedly contain successful `IllusionEffect` spawn lines, but the spawned positions are often far from the active Railway Station gas event. The apparent “no copies” symptom is caused by map-order enemy selection consuming the cap away from the local encounter.

## Changes

- `scripts/effects/chemical_cloud.gd`
  - Keeps wall-safe candidate validation for original enemy movement.
  - Adds `_get_alive_enemies_sorted_by_cloud_distance()`.
  - Refactors cluster spawning into `_spawn_illusion_cluster_for_enemy()`.
  - Uses nearest-enemy priority for initial and progressive illusion spawning.

- `tests/unit/test_chemical_cloud_illusions.gd`
  - Updates the original-position test to match center-as-fallback behavior.
  - Adds regression coverage that nearest alive enemies are processed before far enemies and dead enemies are excluded.
  - Retains wall-inside, wall-crossing, open-space, null-world, and candidate-index tests.

- `docs/case-studies/issue-1632/`
  - Adds downloaded gameplay logs, GitHub issue/PR metadata, and a case-study README with timeline, root cause, and verification targets.

## How to reproduce before the fix

1. Play Railway Station or another large level with a gas-mask enemy.
2. Trigger a chemical grenade while the player is near visible gas.
3. Observe that logs may report spawned illusion copies, while the visible local encounter appears to have none because the cap was spent on distant enemies.

## Test plan

- [x] `git diff --check` clean.
- [x] Downloaded and analyzed owner-provided logs.
- [x] Added/updated regression tests in `tests/unit/test_chemical_cloud_illusions.gd`.
- [ ] Local GUT targeted run: attempted with downloaded Godot 4.3 mono, but local invocation did not select the single script correctly and repo autoload/test bootstrap emitted unrelated existing parse warnings. CI should run the canonical workflow.
- [ ] CI `Run GUT Tests` passes on latest commit.
- [ ] Manual: Railway Station gas-mask grenade, confirm copies appear around enemies local to the visible gas and the original enemy does not teleport through walls.

Issue: https://github.com/Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP/issues/1632

…on spawn

When a ChemicalCloud spawns illusion copies for a gas-mask enemy's
grenade, the original enemy was teleported to a random offset (60-120px)
without any collision check. In narrow corridors this occasionally placed
the enemy inside or behind wall geometry.

Validate the candidate position with the physics server before
teleporting: reject candidates that sit inside an obstacle collider
(intersect_point on layer 3) and candidates whose straight path from the
current position crosses a wall (intersect_ray). Non-center offsets are
shuffled and validated first; the original's current position (offset 0)
is used only as a no-move fallback when every random candidate fails.
This preserves the random-position behavior from Issue #1361 while
preventing wall clipping.

Fixes Jhon-Crow/godot-topdown-MVP#1632
